title: Fourth norm monotonicity
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite set, and let $f,g:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$. If $|f(x)|\\le g(x)$ for every $x\\in\\Omega$, then the uniform $L^4$ norm of $f$ is at most that of $g$.
